raw_segments.text: France, this is most strange, that she, who even but now was your best object, the argument
of your praise, balm of your age, the best, the dearest, should in this trice of time
commit a thing so monstrous, to dismantle so many folds of favor.
Sure her offense must be of such unnatural degree that monsters it, or your fore-vouched
affection fall into taint, which to believe of her must be a faith that reason without
miracle should never plant in me.
This is the end of this video.
